reason: Modelled as an actuator with inputs INA1/INB1/PWM1 and INA2/INB2/PWM2. The driver follows the ST truth table (CW, CCW, brake to GND/VCC, coast with PWM=0, 20 kHz PWM) and the CS formula K=11370 into 1.5 kOhm. VIN gets an external 5.5-16 V supply, EN1/EN2 are optional with their 4.7 kOhm pull-up to 5 V, and CS1/CS2 are optional through a divider. The part check passed on ESP32 and Pico on the first run; the 3.3 V logic margin (VIH 3.25 V min) is documented.
